pending_qa.q: What assessment approach reveals HR team readiness levels for AI adoption?
pending_qa.r: Diana's team took time to listen and understand where each person was on their AI journey—some didn't yet understand what a prompt was while others were already experimenting. Through this listening, they discovered that approximately 25% to 30% of their team actually trusted AI enough to utilize it in the workspace, which gave them a clear baseline from which to build significant shifts in trust and empowerment.

pending_qa.q: What practical AI use cases can HR teams implement across workforce operations?
pending_qa.r: Seneca Polytechnic deployed AI across workforce planning, organizational design, job architecture, change management, and compensation analysis. One standout example is creating personas for change management by analyzing organizational data at the thematic level to build archetypes, which they use as a first line of testing to improve deliverables and navigate organizational complexities.

pending_qa.q: Why should AI agents be formally integrated into organizational charts?
pending_qa.r: Diana intentionally embedded agents into Seneca's org chart to create clarity and ownership around who manages each agent and holds responsibility for its output. This integration adds a governance layer, allows for defining workflows, establishes purpose and defined responsibility for each agent, and enables performance management and continuous improvement tracking—treating AI agents not as simple chatbots but as managed entities with roles HR professionals actively develop and monitor.

pending_qa.q: What operational improvements result from digitizing HR service delivery and automating routine work?
pending_qa.r: More than 90% of Seneca's employee interactions moved onto the ServiceNow platform, compared to being spread across email, phone, fax and other channels four years prior. Average response times dropped from nearly two weeks to less than 24 hours. The team refreshed over 100 knowledge articles to improve self-service user experience and focused data governance and quality to enable better analysis and decision-making.

pending_qa.q: What foundational elements must precede successful AI implementation in HR transformation?
pending_qa.r: Diana advises that before the AI frenzy began, focusing on fundamentals—data governance, process redesign, and knowledge management—provided essential blocks to launch from. She emphasizes that AI is driven by good data, good processes, and good knowledge, so clearing up these fundamentals first enables leaps and bounds in both AI and transformation journeys.

pending_qa.q: How does AI enable HR to shift from transactional to strategic value delivery?
pending_qa.r: By automating monotonous operational work, Seneca's HR team freed capacity to focus on higher-value activities that excite and develop their capability. This shift allowed HRBPs to focus on relationships and advising rather than transacting, and enabled leaders to receive better workforce insights and have deeper business conversations, creating more meaningful support for the institution.
